scientific_integrity: The all-length sharp runner-up theorem uses a cited, inspected source run identity and gives its own strict second-level comparison. The known alternating global maximum and source finite runner-up examples are explicitly credited, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Uniform prior on binary length-(n+2) input words and exactly two uniformly selected deleted positions.
The run identity and adjacent-increment inequality are cited from arXiv:2611.01064v1; no independent certification of those established premises is claimed.
Finite computations check examples and do not prove the all-length result.
Historical priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent works.
title: The sharp second-highest input entropy for binary two-deletion channels
